title: [Bug]: AMF crash after UE release request

labels.name: Housekeeping:ToClose
labels.description: Issues reviewed and closed. Old requests, issues which are not bug, feature or documentation request

body:
### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag

v2.6.4

### Steps to reproduce

Hello,
We start to play with Open5GS and gNB Nokia. But sometime when we set UE in airplane mode, AMF crashed and process is killed. Sometime it's appear only after we turned off airplane mode.
